Sale.title: Sale
Sale.description: Recorded sales transaction item in the sales ledger (cash, card, traded out, or online)

operatorName.description: Counter operator vendor who rang up the sale on the device

amount.description: Net sale value collected in GBP

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for sales ledger transaction

isMiscellaneous.description: Whether item is a miscellaneous sale

dateKey.description: Calendar date string in YYYY-MM-DD format

isOnlineSale.description: Whether this sale came from scanning an online inventory card

onlineCardId.description: ID of the associated online card

onlineBarcode.description: Barcode number of the associated online card

checkoutGroupId.description: Shared checkout group identifier for multi-item baskets and split payments

checkoutTotalAmount.description: Combined checkout total across all basket/split legs in GBP

basketItemCount.description: Number of items included in the basket checkout

storeCreditCustomerId.description: Optional customer ID whose store credit was redeemed on this sale

storeCreditCustomerName.description: Optional customer name whose store credit was redeemed

storeCreditAmount.description: Amount paid using customer store credit in GBP

relatedHoldId.description: Linked layaway or customer hold document ID

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description: Registered active vendor in the team roster

color.description: Assigned theme color hex code for the vendor

Trade.title: Trade
Trade.description: Recorded trade-in transaction: cards traded in for cash or for credit (vendors credit)

operatorName.description: Counter operator who rang up the trade-in on this device

itemDescription.description: Description of the cards or items traded in

tradeValue.description: Agreed valuation in GBP of the traded cards

tradeType.description: Compensation method: cards traded in for cash or for credit (vendors credit)

customerName.description: Optional customer name trading in cards

storeCreditCustomerId.description: Linked StoreCreditCustomer ID when credit is added to customer balance

notes.description: Optional notes or terms regarding the trade

OnlineCard.title: OnlineCard
OnlineCard.description: Online card with barcode, vendor attribution, name, price, status and sales tracking

cardName.description: Name or title of the card

soldAt.description: Timestamp when sold via barcode scanner

saleId.description: ID of the sale record in the sales ledger

soldPaymentMethod.description: How the card was sold: online or in-person (cash, card, traded out)

RemovedVendor.title: RemovedVendor
RemovedVendor.description: Tombstone record for a removed vendor to guarantee deletion synchronization across all devices

CashReconciliation.title: CashReconciliation
CashReconciliation.description: End-of-day till cash drawer reconciliation record per calendar day

actualCashCounted.description: Actual physical cash counted at end of day in GBP

notes.description: Optional close-of-day variance or banking notes

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when last saved

StoreCreditCustomer.title: StoreCreditCustomer
StoreCreditCustomer.description: Customer store credit account tracking remaining balance, phone contact, and lifetime totals

normalizedName.description: Lowercase trimmed customer name for lookup

phone.description: Optional customer phone number or social handle

balance.description: Current available store credit balance in GBP

totalIssued.description: Lifetime store credit issued in GBP

totalRedeemed.description: Lifetime store credit redeemed in GBP

StoreCreditTransaction.title: StoreCreditTransaction
StoreCreditTransaction.description: Audit log entry for store credit issuance, redemption at checkout, or manual balance adjustment

type.description: Transaction type: issue from trade/top-up, redeem at checkout, or manual adjust

amount.description: Absolute GBP amount of the change

delta.description: Signed GBP delta applied to balance

balanceAfter.description: Customer balance in GBP immediately after transaction

description.description: Reason or item description for transaction

relatedTradeId.description: Linked trade document ID if issued from a trade-in

relatedCheckoutGroupId.description: Linked checkout group ID if redeemed on a basket/split sale

relatedSaleId.description: Linked sale document ID if redeemed on a single sale

Hold.title: Hold
Hold.description: Customer hold / layaway record tracking reserved items, deposits, installment payments, and balance due

customerPhone.description: Optional customer phone number or social handle

operatorName.description: Counter operator who created the hold

itemDescription.description: Description of held cards or items

depositPaid.description: Cumulative deposits paid so far in GBP

dueDateKey.description: Target pickup or hold expiry date YYYY-MM-DD

payments.description: Installment payments recorded toward this hold

completedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds when paid off & picked up

GiftCard.title: GiftCard
GiftCard.description: Physical market gift card tracked by scanned barcode/QR serial number with live balance and status

barcode.description: Scanned barcode, QR code, or serial code printed on the physical gift card

balance.description: Current remaining GBP balance on the gift card

initialValue.description: Initial GBP amount loaded when first activated

totalLoaded.description: Cumulative GBP value loaded onto the card

totalRedeemed.description: Cumulative GBP value redeemed from the card

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the gift card

notes.description: Optional notes about the gift card

soldPaymentMethod.description: Payment method used when purchasing the gift card

soldVendorName.description: Optional vendor attribution if recorded in sales ledger

operatorName.description: Till operator who activated the card

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in epoch milliseconds

lastUsedAt.description: Timestamp of last redemption or top-up in epoch milliseconds

GiftCardTransaction.title: GiftCardTransaction
GiftCardTransaction.description: Audit log entry for gift card activation, redemption, top-up, adjustment, or voiding

giftCardId.description: Document ID of the associated GiftCard

barcode.description: Scanned barcode string of the gift card

amount.description: Absolute GBP amount of the event

delta.description: Signed GBP delta applied to card balance

balanceAfter.description: Remaining GBP balance immediately after the transaction

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for activation or top-up

vendorName.description: Optional vendor associated with the purchase or redemption

operatorName.description: Till operator who processed the transaction

description.description: Summary description of the gift card transaction

relatedSaleId.description: Optional linked sale document ID in sales collection

/sales/{saleId}.description: Collection of all sales ledger records (cash, card, traded out, or online) across terminals

/salesmen/{salesmanId}.description: Collection of team vendors roster across terminals

/trades/{tradeId}.description: Collection of trade-in records (cards traded in for cash or credit) across terminals

/online_cards/{cardId}.description: Collection of online cards and barcodes synced in real-time across all devices

/removed_vendors/{vendorId}.description: Collection of removed vendors synced across all devices

/cash_reconciliations/{dateKey}.description: Collection of daily cash drawer float and end-of-day cash reconciliation counts synced across devices

/store_credit_customers/{customerId}.description: Collection of customer store credit accounts and balances synced across terminals

/store_credit_transactions/{txId}.description: Audit log of all store credit issuances, redemptions, and adjustments synced across terminals

/holds/{holdId}.description: Customer holds, deposits, and layaway plans synced across terminals

/gift_cards/{cardId}.description: Scanned market gift cards with live balances and status synced across all terminals

/gift_card_transactions/{txId}.description: Audit trail of gift card activations, redemptions, top-ups, and adjustments synced across terminals
